# Sympathy for Data

> > A low-code analytics platform for time-series analysis, data visualization, and machine learning workflows across manufacturing and R&D industries.

Sympathy for Data is a visual data analytics platform built on node-based workflows, ADAF data format, and Python integration. Founded by Combine Control Systems AB in Sweden, it provides enterprise-grade tools for data processing, ETL pipelines, image analysis, and predictive modeling without requiring extensive coding.

## Key Topics

- Low-code platform
- Node-based workflows
- Time-series analysis
- Data visualization
- Machine learning (Scikit-learn)
- ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)
- Anomaly detection
- Image processing
- Manufacturing analytics
- ADAF format
- Python integration
- CSV/Excel data import
- Quality monitoring
- Workflow automation
- Enterprise Toolkits

## Key Capabilities

- [Time series data analysis](https://www.sympathyfordata.com/time-series-data-analysis): Time series analysis for machine performance & anomaly detection
- [Generate impressive data visualisations in an instant](https://www.sympathyfordata.com/data-visualisation): Data visualization capabilities for analytics and insights
- [Image processing workflows](https://www.sympathyfordata.com/image-analysis): Image processing and analysis workflows with ML integration
- [ML analysis](https://www.sympathyfordata.com/features/ml-analysis): Machine learning analysis with Scikit-learn and decision trees

## Industry Solutions

- [Data analysis for manufacturing and large industries](https://www.sympathyfordata.com/manufacturing): Manufacturing analytics for quality monitoring and optimization
- [R&D](https://www.sympathyfordata.com/r-and-d): R&D analytics and predictive modeling capabilities
